definitions.aggregation:
T46 CL3 copy of the CL2 agg_cl.py. CL3 changes: arms C1a / C1aF1 (= C1a + --nontarget-evidence surface) / C1aF1F2 (= C1aF1 + --owned-ambiguous remove);
pairs C1a-C1aF1, C1aF1-C1aF1F2 (+ C1a-C1aF1F2); cross_day = reproducibility CL2 C1a (results/development/20261012T040647+0900_f14ae3e6b62b_d600316277ef/verify/T44/CL2/agg.json runs)
vs CL3 C1a on the same (episode, seed) (same pair_table fields) + CL2 C0 / C1a vs CL3 arms (reference); t7_pre_grasp (analyze_cl pre_grasp: hold chunks in the
pre8+close window) and t8_t46 (analyze_cl t46: F1 / F2 activity from chunk stats) per arm. Definitions otherwise unchanged (CL2 = T44d).
T44e CL2 aggregation (verifier, CPU only, numbers only) = port of results/workspace/verify/T44/CL/p/agg_cl.py (md5 65e6256c...). usage: agg_cl.py OUT_JSON
Inputs: CL2/analysis/<NAME>.json (analyze_cl.py), CL2/replay/<ARM>_R_<NAME>.{json,npz} (replay_contacts.py), results/workspace/verify/T44/LB2/passed.json.
Arms C0, C1a, C1bp (= C1b'), C2p (= C2'). Definitions below are T44d's, unchanged.
CL2 additions: pairs C0-C1a, C1a-C1bp, C1bp-C2p (+ C0-C1bp, C0-C2p); cross_day = same (episode, seed) of this run vs the T44d record
  results/workspace/verify/T44/CL/agg.json runs (T44d C0 / C1a / C1b / C2 vs CL2 C0 / C1a / C1bp / C2p; different day, different checkout / environment),
  same pair_table fields computed from the stored per-run flags (any_new_contact from contacts_rows of the three CT classes).

Definitions
  task success      : analyze_t42 success = grasp (target z >= z0 + 50 mm) and place (target centre in the crate interior at the last planning row)
  Z4 release rule   : T43 CT z4 rule generalised to the episode's target fruit (replay state target_pos instead of apple_pos, contact class hand-target instead of apple-hand):
                      release_t = (last row with a hand-target contact sub-step) + 1 (must be before the run's end and grasp true); sep_threshold = d(target, finger midpoint at grasp_t) + 30 mm;
                      sep_kept = d > threshold on every row from the first row >= release_t with d > threshold to the end; released = release_t and sep_kept; success_rel = grasp and released and target in crate at end
  new contact classes (replay_contacts.py): hand-fruit_other, robot_other-target, robot_other-fruit_other, hand-target (hand = subtree EE_BODY + both fingers of the active arm; robot_other = every other robot geom
                      incl. the inactive hand; fruit_other = the other three fruit bodies; target = the episode's target fruit)
  pre-release       : control rows t <= release_t (release_t None: every row)
  CT success (success_ct) = success and success_rel and no pre-release contact in {hand-fruit_other, robot_other-target, robot_other-fruit_other}   (V11 CT rule, obstacle := neighbour fruit / non-hand link on the target)
  success_ct_fruit  = same but only {hand-fruit_other, robot_other-fruit_other}
  grasp (final)     : analyze_t42 grasp ; first grasp ok = grasp and no regrasp (one close before the lift) ; regrasp = >= 2 close commands before the lift (grasp_robust) ; slip = slip_B (rule B)
  robust grasp      : grasp and not slip_B and not regrasp (grasp_robust robust_grasp), the LB2 selection criterion
McNemar exact two-sided: min(b, c) binomial, p = min(1, 2 P) on (episode, seed) pairs.
definitions.pre8_close_hold: close_seq = first server chunk (run order) with grasp.state == 'closing'; window = chunks with close_seq-8 <= seq <= close_seq (V-T45 / D-TF pre8+close); HOLD chunk = planning row whose control rows were not all executed (analyze_cl); same rule applied to the CL2 analysis files (agg/cl2_pre_grasp.json)
definitions.t46_activity: per server chunk from summary target_exclusion (+ esdf_stats.target_free for n_ambiguous_removed): F1 present = nontarget.evidence recorded; applied = evidence.applied (surface fit accepted); n_dropped = evidence points removed; F2 = n_ambiguous_removed (ambiguous seeds removed); n_ambiguous = classified count (includes removed)
definitions.foreign_gpu_overlap:
T46 CL3 (verifier, lead request): foreign GPU process intervals and per-run overlap. usage: foreign_overlap.py OUT_JSON
Sources: (A) every CL3 server's gpu_samples.txt ('<epoch> <whole-GPU memory.used MiB>' every 2 s while that server lived; runs/*/server_*, startup_check/*/server_*);
         (B) raw/foreign_gpu_samples.txt (60 s: n_gpu_apps vs n_our_servers, from 07:45 UTC); (C) server gpu_mem.txt app lists at run ends.
Foreign (A): at sample time t, n_ours(t) = number of our server sample files whose [first, last] covers t; excess = used(t) - OUR_MIB * n_ours(t);
  foreign if excess > EXCESS_MIB on >= MIN_SAMPLES consecutive samples (any file). OUR_MIB = 18200 (max per-server app memory seen in gpu_mem.txt 18060 + margin).
  Interval = [first, last] sample time of such a stretch (+- 2 s).
Foreign (B): napps > nours; interval = sample time +- 30 s.
A run overlaps if [.start, .end] intersects any foreign interval (A or B). Times in epoch seconds / ISO UTC.
definitions.variants: all = 54 original runs; no_overlap = runs with foreign_gpu_overlap dropped (pairs with a dropped side excluded); supp_substituted = those 4 runs replaced by the supplementary reruns
